content.text:
All 18 playbook rules reviewed and submitted. Summary:

**Deviations redlined (7):**
- **EXCLUSIVITY** (§2.2) — sole-and-exclusive provider for the full term; deleted (contradicts §12.3 too).
- **MFN** (§7.2) — open-ended MFN in Vendor's favour; deleted.
- **LD** (§7.6) — USD 25,000/day liquidated damages payable by us; deleted.
- **RENEWAL** (§8.2) — 180-day non-renewal window shortened to 30 days.
- **T4C** (new §9.4) — no convenience exit in a 3-year term; added 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund.
- **NOSOLICIT** (§12.4) — 18-month, all-personnel, no-hire restriction narrowed to a mutual 12-month non-solicit with advertising/unsolicited carve-outs.
- **AUDIT** (§22.1) — unlimited, unannounced audits with remote system access limited to annual, 30 days' notice, independent auditor, no system access.

**Compliant (11):** LOL-CAP, INDEMN, NONCOMPETE, GOVLAW, ASSIGN, IP, LICENSE, WARRANTY, INSURANCE, MINCOMMIT, TRANSITION — all at or above our preferred positions (only a missing 60-day renewal reminder noted, not flagged).
